solico.label: About the group
solico.title: Solico Group
solico.lead: One of the region's largest food groups. Its story began in 1973.
solico.storyTitle: From raw materials to the shop shelf
paragraphs: Solico Group makes dairy and protein products, ready-to-eat food, beverages and health-focused products. They are sold across Iran and in more than 40 countries.

The group manages every stage of the value chain, from sourcing raw materials and developing products to manufacturing, logistics and distribution. Each day more than 3,000 tonnes of products go out to shops across Iran.
Its head office is in Dubai, UAE, with offices in Tehran, Baghdad and Erbil. Sofood Kaz is the group's production company in Kazakhstan.

founder.label: Founder
founder.name: Gholamali Soleimani
paragraphs: Gholamali Soleimani was born on 15 June 1946 in Amol, northern Iran. He studied mathematics at the National University of Iran.
Mathematics and analysis shaped the way he approached business. He started in market research, moved into entrepreneurship and then into the food industry.

historyLink.label: History
historyLink.title: More than five decades from the first steps to an international group

items.title: An integrated value chain
items.text: Every stage is managed in-house, from sourcing raw materials to final distribution.

items.title: A wide production network
items.text: More than 25 food production sites and manufacturing complexes.

items.title: Continuous innovation
items.text: Steady investment in research and in new products. The group launched Asia's first milk refinery of its kind.

items.text: From everyday staples to baby food and health-focused products.

history.label: History
history.title: History of Solico Group
history.lead: From the first company in 1973 to the complex in Konaev.

items.title: The first steps
items.text: Parsio and MRS are founded and the group enters food sourcing and distribution. Hamburger production begins and the Solico brand is registered.

items.title: Building the value chain
items.text: The range grows to seafood, meat products and pickles. In 1988 Solico exports its products for the first time.

items.title: The dairy era
items.text: The group enters the dairy industry under the Kalleh brand: milk, yoghurt, ice cream, milk powder, cheeses and dairy desserts.

items.title: A national distribution network
items.text: 31 provincial distribution centres, pre-ordering systems and a route-to-market model take products from the factories to shops across Iran.

items.title: Regional expansion
items.text: Exports gather pace: products reach the UAE, Iraq, Afghanistan and the CIS markets.

items.title: Technology and transformation
items.text: SAP, ERP and the TAMIZ platform connect the group's processes. Asia's first milk refinery of its kind opens, and manufacturing starts in the UAE through SOFOOD.

items.title: Today and the road ahead
items.text: The group expands specialised milk refining, baby food and health-focused products, and looks at new areas of food and nutrition.

items.title: Construction in Konaev
items.text: Sofood Kaz builds phase one of the dairy complex in Kazakhstan. In October the plans are presented to the Prime Minister at KGIR-2026.

history.outro: Today the group has more than 70 active brands.

factory.label: The factory
factory.title: The dairy complex in Konaev
factory.lead: The cheese plant is phase one. Three more production sites and a packaging area follow.
paragraphs: Phase one is a cheese plant with a capacity of 40,920 tonnes of products a year. It will make cream, hard and brined cheeses, ultrafiltered cheese, cream cheese, labneh and mozzarella.
The full complex is phase one plus three more production sites and a packaging area of about 4 hectares. Central and technical warehouses and the utilities sit on the same site.

The project runs under an investment agreement with the Ministry of Agriculture of the Republic of Kazakhstan. On 22 October 2026 the plans were presented to the Prime Minister at the Kazakhstan Global Investment Roundtable (KGIR-2026).
